statement: Function.LeftInverse (unj n) (j n) ∧ Function.RightInverse (unj n) (j n)
proof:
constructor
· intro p
  apply WithLp.ofLp_injective 2
  apply Prod.ext
  · apply PiLp.ext
    intro i
    simp [unj, j, WithLp.fst]
  · simp [unj, j, WithLp.snd]
· intro v
  apply PiLp.ext
  intro i
  change Fin.snoc (α := fun _ : Fin (n+1) => ℝ) (fun h : Fin n => v h.castSucc) (v (Fin.last n)) i = v i
  exact congrFun (Fin.snoc_init_self v.ofLp) i
